title: QA Pilot QA Packet Ingest
description: Schema for a governed QA export packet ingested from Librarian into QA Pilot local derived storage. Enforces custody, provenance, authority status, and use boundaries.

packet_type.description: Type of governed QA export packet.

authority_status.description: Authority classification of this packet. authoritative_export = canonical Librarian state; advisory_copy = derived/replicated; training_simulated = not real authority.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of packet generation.

source_db_revision.description: Revision identifier from the source project DB at time of export.

source_packet_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the packet content for integrity verification.

source_docs.description: Paths or identifiers of source documents in the originating project.

allowed_use.description: Permitted use categories for this packet in the consuming project.

forbidden_use.description: Must include all forbidden-use categories. Any packet missing a forbidden use is rejected.

owner_decision_required_for_apply.description: Must be true — Owner decision is always required before any apply action.

payload.description: Optional packet payload containing the actual data being exported.
